notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
We have fixed a couple of the most prevalent bugs and corrected some of the story flow issues which have been discussed in the forums:

- We have cleared the "car crashes"

- Removed the faulty large skip in story line.

- Achievements are now  correctly set up.

- Car cut scene no longer repeats twice.

- Tried to fix as many typos as possible (very hard to get them all without hiring a professional proof reader).

Thank you so much for the overwhelming support and the great reviews that have come in thus far. Please do share this game with anyone who you think would be interested in this old point-and-click (on keyboard!) style adventure. Would also like to give a big shout out to all the YouTubers who have made Let's Plays of the game, thanks so much for helping us promote the game.

Just to keep you all informed, we are in the works for Silver Creek Falls Chapter 2 and we're aiming to release in September this year.

Keep up the gaming and don't forget to be awesome!

The Sapphire Dragon Production Team
